description: Submit a private inquiry only after the human user explicitly asks you to contact Zhiyong about a specific product and explicitly agrees to the stated reply-only data use. Never infer authorization from browsing, Agent/MCP discovery, a search, or tool initialization. Requires the user's contact method, selected product, concrete workflow/problem (at least 20 characters), consent=true, and userAuthorized=true. This stores a lead; it is not a purchase or confirmed customer.

consent.description: The user has agreed that these details are stored only to reply to this inquiry.

contact.description: Contact method provided by the user for this inquiry.

problem.description: Concrete workflow and current problem, in the user's own terms.

userAuthorized.description: The user explicitly requested this contact action.

name: submit_business_inquiry
title: Submit a user-authorized product inquiry
